PLAN "Pregnancy Strength - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength through pregnancy without supine work, max efforts, or high-impact loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
          lat_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          wood_chop 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          cat_cow 3m
